title: 英語学習 / 文ごとの発話とジェスチャー

segments.motion_prompt: Give a friendly greeting by raising your right hand to shoulder height and waving. Stand in place and keep facing forward.

segments.text: 今日も一緒に楽しく英語を勉強しましょう！
segments.motion_prompt: Welcome the listener with both hands open in a friendly inviting gesture at chest height, then relax your arms. Stand in place and keep facing forward.

segments.text: まずは英語で挨拶してみよう。
segments.motion_prompt: Demonstrate a small friendly greeting by lifting your right hand and gently waving, then lower it. Stand in place and keep facing forward.
Give a friendly greeting wave with your right hand, then open your left palm toward the listener in a gentle questioning gesture. Stand in place and keep facing forward.

segments.text: 元気なときは、I'm happy! って言ってみてね。
segments.motion_prompt: Bring both open hands toward your chest in an upbeat encouraging gesture, then gently present your open palms toward the listener. Stand in place and keep facing forward.
